title: Flex Backup Snapshot
description: Details for one snapshot of a flex cluster.

expiration.description: Date and time when the download link no longer works. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

finishTime.description: Date and time when MongoDB Cloud completed writing this snapshot. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

id.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the snapshot.

links.description: List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships.

mongoDBVersion.description: MongoDB host version that the snapshot runs.

scheduledTime.description: Date and time when MongoDB Cloud will take the snapshot. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

startTime.description: Date and time when MongoDB Cloud began taking the snapshot. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

status.description: Phase of the workflow for this snapshot at the time this resource made this request.

href.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that points another API resource to which this response has some relationship. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

rel.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that defines the semantic relationship between this resource and another API resource. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.
